messages:
Maya: Customer on EU contract reporting a €0.02 mismatch between their billing statement total and the usage dashboard after VAT/proration. They say dashboard shows 123.45 EUR but statement final charge is 123.47 EUR. Can we confirm where the extra cents are coming from?

Carlos: Which account/invoice? can you paste the statement lines? might be rounding on per-line VAT or currency conversion. cc @Priya for metering side

Maya: Account: acct_48XJ, Statement id: stmt_2026_04_12_48XJ. Pasting anonymized statement lines below (source CSV export):
```
line_id,description,base_amount,currency,vat_percent,vat_amount,rounded_total
1,API usage - gen,49.9932,EUR,20,9.99864,59.99
2,API usage - emb,73.4567,EUR,20,14.69134,88.15
3,Service fee,0.0000,EUR,20,0.00000,0.00
SUM,123.4499, , ,24.6900,148.14  <-- hmm
```
(note: dashboard shows total 123.45 before VAT, invoice shows pre-tax 123.45 and final 148.16)

Priya: From quick look: per-request token billing rounds at request level to 4 decimals, but ledger aggregation uses cents and then VAT is computed per-line and rounded to cents. Small remainders from converting micro-eur amounts then summing can cause +/− a few cents. Need the raw usage export (per-request rows) for a narrow time window to repro.

Maya: Uploaded usage slice to the shared bucket: s3://redwood-support/repro/acct_48XJ/2026-04-11-12-14.csv (sample attached). Here's the first few rows:
```
request_ts,model,tokens,unit_price_eur,charge_eur
2026-04-11T12:01:03Z,gpt-3x,120,0.00041,0.04920
2026-04-11T12:01:05Z,emb-1x,300,0.00010,0.03000
2026-04-11T12:02:11Z,gpt-3x,400,0.00041,0.16400
...
```

Alex: VAT calculation logic: we currently compute VAT per-invoice-line after summing request-level charges into lines, then round VAT to nearest cent per line. EU contract requires summing VAT per-line, but some customers expect VAT on the summed subtotal which can shift by 1-2 cents. Also currency conversions to EUR from USD (when applicable) use bank rates then rounding.

Carlos: Repro steps for engineers: 1) run aggregation SQL with current pipeline: `SELECT SUM(ROUND(charge_eur::numeric,2)) FROM usage WHERE account='acct_48XJ' AND day='2026-04-11'` 2) compute VAT per-line: `vat = ROUND(line_amount*0.20,2)` 3) compare to `ROUND(SUM(line_amount)*0.20,2)` 4) run with `ROUND(SUM(charge_eur::numeric),2)` vs no per-line rounding to see delta.

Priya: I ran a quick local repro: using per-request rounding then per-line VAT yields final 148.16; using summed-subtotal-then-VAT yields 148.14. Difference = 0.02 EUR. So behavior matches customer report.

Carlos: Options: a) show a separate "rounding adjustment" line on future statements and explain; b) change invoice generation to use summed-subtotal-then-tax (need legal/account sign-off for EU VAT policy); c) adjust dashboard to mirror invoice rounding so both match.

Jamie: Customer-facing: can we provide an explanation + ETA? customer asked for resolution before EOD PST.

Carlos: I'll draft a note: explain per-line VAT rounding policy and attach a mini-reconciliation table (we can auto-generate). ETA: I can prepare the reconciliation and proposed change with Priya by EOD.

invoice-bot: Invoice stmt_2026_04_12_48XJ generated at 2026-04-12T18:32:10Z (checksum ok)

Maya: Thanks — please include a one-line reconciliation showing both methods and the +0.02 rounding delta. I'll update customer once Carlos confirms. :thumbsup:
